<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="מנחם אב_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518920090_theRebbe_103" batchId="meluket-_D7_9E_D7_A0_D7_97_D7_9D_20_D7_90_D7_91_meluket__BH_POST_1766518920090_theRebbe_103__p003">
  <section v="6">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The commandments are called a covenant because they contain two aspects: physical objects and the Supernal Will, which are unified.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And likewise, the commandments are called a covenant,</t>
    <t s="1">because in the commandments there are also two aspects,</t>
    <t s="2">for they themselves are made from physical things,</t>
    <t s="3">and in them is the drawing down of the Supernal Will,</t>
    <t s="4">for Will is above wisdom.</t>
    <t s="5">And these two aspects in the commandments are not two separate matters,</t>
    <t s="6">but rather they are one matter,</t>
    <t s="7">for the commandments that are clothed in physical things,</t>
    <t s="8">they themselves are the Supernal Will,</t>
    <t s="9">for thus it arose in His Will to fulfill the commandments specifically in physicality.</t>
    <t s="10">And because He is the Will of the Blessed One that is above even wisdom,</t>
    <t s="11">therefore it descends below specifically into physical things.</t>
    <t s="12">However, this very thing—that through Torah and commandments it will be possible for the unification of the souls of Israel with Ein Sof—</t>
    <t s="13">for seemingly,</t>
    <t s="14">since Ein Sof is not at all from any of these attributes,</t>
    <t s="15">how can the action of lower beings take hold so that there will be a face-to-face unification,</t>
    <t s="16">since He is not at all from any of these attributes,</t>
    <t s="17">it is impossible for there to be a face-to-face unification,</t>
    <t s="18">whether from the side of Ein Sof or from the side of the souls of Israel—</t>
    <t s="19">concerning this it is said, "I stand between Hashem and you to tell you the word of Hashem,"</t>
    <t s="20">for "I am who I am" is the aspect of Keter that is above both of them,</t>
    <t s="21">and through the power of Keter, unification is effected through the Torah.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="7">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>The verse "And it will be, because you will listen" refers to gathering the scattered sparks of the soul and the laws of Torah, which enables unification.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">3)</t>
    <t s="1">And this is, "And it will be, because you will listen to these judgments,"</t>
    <t s="2">for behold,</t>
    <t s="3">the translation of "judgment" is "halacha,"</t>
    <t s="4">which is the matter of the laws of the Torah,</t>
    <t s="5">and this means that since this verse explains the unification of the souls of Israel with the Holy One, blessed be He, as above,</t>
    <t s="6">therefore it says "these judgments,"</t>
    <t s="7">for the unification is through the laws of the Torah.</t>
    <t s="8">And "you will listen" is an expression of gathering,</t>
    <t s="9">like "And Shaul gathered," etc.,</t>
    <t s="10">and the matter is to gather and collect all the scattered sparks of his Divine soul that became bound to foreign desires,</t>
    <t s="11">through the multitude of thoughts and the scattering of the soul,</t>
    <t s="12">for although it is written,</t>
    <t s="13">"And Hashem your God will bless you in all that you do" specifically,</t>
    <t s="14">that the action must be in physicality,</t>
    <t s="15">nevertheless,</t>
    <t s="16">the thought need not be immersed in this,</t>
    <t s="17">and as it is written,</t>
    <t s="18">"When you eat the labor of your hands,"</t>
    <t s="19">that it should be only the labor of the hands,</t>
    <t s="20">but not the labor of the mind and heart,</t>
    <t s="21">therefore one must gather the sparks that were scattered through the scattering of the soul,</t>
    <t s="22">and as it is written,</t>
    <t s="23">"If your dispersed will be at the ends of the heavens, from there He will gather you."</t>
    <t s="24">And just as one must gather the scattered sparks of his soul,</t>
    <t s="25">so too must there be gathering in the laws of the Torah,</t>
    <t s="26">for from the scattering that occurred in his soul,</t>
    <t s="27">there is caused for him concealment and hiding also in the Torah,</t>
    <t s="28">so that he cannot clarify and rule on the law in its truth,</t>
    <t s="29">and concerning this it says, "you will listen to the judgments,"</t>
    <t s="30">these are the laws,</t>
    <t s="31">for "you will listen" is gathering,</t>
    <t s="32">that there must be gathering in his soul and gathering in the laws of the Torah.</t>
    <t s="33">And this is also what is written,</t>
    <t s="34">"And you will gather your grain, your wine, and your oil,"</t>
    <t s="35">for the souls of Israel are called by the name "your grain, your wine, and your oil,"</t>
    <t s="36">and they are three divisions of levels in the souls of Israel,</t>
    <t s="37">Kohanim, Leviim, and Yisraelim.</t>
    <t s="38">"Your grain" refers to Yisraelim,</t>
    <t s="39">for just as in physicality, bread is the main thing,</t>
    <t s="40">for "bread sustains the heart of man,"</t>
    <t s="41">and the other foods are only additions to the bread,</t>
    <t s="42">so too in the souls of Israel, the main thing is Yisraelim,</t>
    <t s="43">for even Kohanim and Leviim are Yisraelim,</t>
    <t s="44">except that they have an additional advantage of Kohanim and Leviim,</t>
    <t s="45">therefore Yisraelim are called "your grain."</t>
    <t s="46">"Your wine" refers to Leviim,</t>
    <t s="47">for the service of the Leviim is in saying song,</t>
    <t s="48">and song is only said over wine.</t>
    <t s="49">"And your oil" refers to Kohanim,</t>
    <t s="50">for their service is in the aspect of oil,</t>
    <t s="51">in quietness and with a willing heart.</t>
    <t s="52">And this is, "And you will gather your grain, your wine, and your oil,"</t>
    <t s="53">which is the matter of gathering the scattered sparks in all three types of the souls of Israel.</t>
    <t s="54">Also, the interpretation of "And you will gather your grain, your wine, and your oil" is the matter of the gathering that must be in the Torah,</t>
    <t s="55">for the Torah is also called by the name "your grain, your wine, and your oil,"</t>
    <t s="56">and they are the divisions of levels that exist in the Torah.</t>
    <t s="57">"Your grain" is the revealed part of the Torah,</t>
    <t s="58">"your wine" is the inner dimension of the Torah,</t>
    <t s="59">the secrets of the Torah,</t>
    <t s="60">and "your oil" is the secrets of secrets,</t>
    <t s="61">like oil that floats on top of wine,</t>
    <t s="62">as explained in Imrei Binah</t>
    <t s="63">at length.</t>
    <t s="64">And this is, "And you will gather your grain, etc.,"</t>
    <t s="65">which is the matter of the gathering that must be in all parts of the Torah.</t>
    <t s="66">And this is, "And it will be, because you will listen to these judgments,"</t>
    <t s="67">that when there is the gathering of the scattered sparks of his soul and the gathering in the Torah,</t>
    <t s="68">and in general it is the service of "you will listen," "and you will guard," and "and you will do," which are from below upward,</t>
    <t s="69">through this there will also be drawn down from above downward,</t>
    <t s="70">so that there will be a face-to-face unification of the souls of Israel and Ein Sof, blessed be He.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="8">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>In the service stemming from the Supernal Will, above reason, there is no need for gathering, and the Torah draws down the light from above the chain of descent.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">4)</t>
    <t s="1">However, all this is in the service from below upward as it is from the side of the lower will born of intellect.</t>
    <t s="2">But in the service as it is from the side of the Supernal Will,</t>
    <t s="3">that is, the service of the will of the heart that is above reason and knowledge,</t>
    <t s="4">which in general is the love of "with all your might" stated in the first paragraph of the Shema,</t>
    <t s="5">behold, in this paragraph the verse "And you will gather your grain, your wine, and your oil" is not mentioned</t>
    <t s="6">(which is done from the matter of "if your dispersed will be," etc.)</t>
    <t s="7">as in the second paragraph of the Shema,</t>
    <t s="8">because from the side of the love of "with all your might,"</t>
    <t s="9">which is the matter of doing the will of the Place,</t>
    <t s="10">as mentioned above</t>
    <t s="11">in the name of the Maggid, that it is the matter of drawing down the Will of the Blessed One that is above the chain of descent,</t>
    <t s="12">behold, from the side of drawing down this aspect, there is no need for the service of gathering,</t>
    <t s="13">for rather, as it is written,</t>
    <t s="14">"And He will bless, etc., your grain, your wine, and your oil,"</t>
    <t s="15">so that there will not be in them the aspect of scattering of the soul to foreign desires, etc.,</t>
    <t s="16">for this matter applies specifically in the chain of descent,</t>
    <t s="17">but from the side of the love of "with all your might" that draws down the will that is above the chain of descent,</t>
    <t s="18">this matter does not apply.</t>
    <t s="19">And this is the true matter of the covenant of Torah,</t>
    <t s="20">for the matter of Torah is a drawing down from above to below,</t>
    <t s="21">that is, the drawing down of the Supernal light as it is</t>
    <t s="22">(not according to the measure of the created beings),</t>
    <t s="23">and it is the light that is above the chain of descent,</t>
    <t s="24">for prayer is an elevation from below to above,</t>
    <t s="25">"And you will gather your grain, etc.,"</t>
    <t s="26">but the Torah is a drawing down from above to below,</t>
    <t s="27">the drawing down of the light that is above the chain of descent,</t>
    <t s="28">and this is through the prior service of the will of the heart,</t>
    <t s="29">the aspect of "with all your might,"</t>
    <t s="30">for then through the Torah is drawn down the light that is above the chain of descent,</t>
    <t s="31">and this is the true matter of the covenant of Torah,</t>
    <t s="32">that the Torah connects and unifies the souls of Israel with the aspect that is above the chain of descent.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
